children: Liberty Energy entered into a supply contract with NES-WES to purchase power generation equipment and related services worth approximately $493.2 million for prospective data center and distributed power projects. The agreement, signed Feb. 13, 2026 and amended May 27, 2026, sets milestone-based payments tied to scheduling, delivery, and takeover. Deliveries and performance testing are planned for 2028 and 2029, with NES-WES subject to liquidated damages for certain delays and performance shortfalls. The deal supports Liberty Energy's buildout of reliable power capacity for new infrastructure.
